subject: Vendr: evidence upload cadence and queueing / presign strategy
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@auriga-health.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Flynn <jordan.flynn@vendr.io>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal intake + upload timing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — Auriga is ready to start providing artifacts for the SIG/SOC2 gapfill, and Vendr suggested we coordinate a small bulk upload window to reduce churn. Two quick asks from our side:

- Can Redwood accept presigned S3 uploads to the Vendr staging bucket, or do you prefer we push via Vendr's API?
- We have a steady stream of documents (SysAudit logs, KMS rotation proof, and a compact SOC2 summary). Can we schedule a daily 30m window for the next two weeks where we upstream a small batch (~10 files) so you can QC and tag CAIQ mappings?

Attaching a short inventory of the initial artifacts.

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
Security Program Manager
Auriga Health

Attachments: auriga-evidence-inventory.csv (text/csv)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@auriga-health.com>
Cc: Jordan Flynn <jordan.flynn@vendr.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal intake + upload timing

Hi Ari — welcome, and glad the demo helped. Short answers up front: presigned S3 uploads are preferred for bulk artifacts (lower failure surface), Vendr API is ok for smaller QnA/proof-of-possession metadata.

Proposal:
- Daily 30m staging window, 13:00–13:30 PT, starting tomorrow (8/20) for 10 business days.
- You upload to a presign folder named /auriga-inbound/YYYYMMDD/; we will run a quick fingerprint+CAIQ-tag pass within the hour.
- For SOC 2 items, please attach a 1–2 line control mapping in the filename (e.g., kms-rotation_SOC2-CC6.pdf) to speed review.

Ben — can you stand up the presign policy and a short playbook for the Auriga team? I put the high-level checklist in the Drive link I shared.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security Integrations (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal intake + upload timing

Ari / Soojin — quick update on presign + queueing:

- I'm provisioning a short-lived IAM role for Auriga that only allows PutObject to /vendr-staging/auriga-inbound/ with object-lock disabled and server-side-encryption required. TTL for presigned URLs will be 12 hours.
- Upload queue: files placed into the staging prefix will be processed by our evidence ingestion worker in 2-minute batches, but we'll hold processing for up to 60 mins during the first day to allow Auriga to correct any misplaced objects.
- Metadata expectations: please include control mappings in the object metadata or the filename (we support X-Amz-Meta-control: SOC2-CC6 style). If you can't attach metadata, include a companion manifest JSON with pointer and mapping.

I'll also paste a minimal presign playbook below for your SRE: step-by-step presigning (curl example), example manifest schema, and a short checklist for certifying KMS key IDs.

Ben Carter
Vendor Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: s3-presign-playbook.md (text/markdown)

From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@auriga-health.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal intake + upload timing

Thanks Ben — that all looks good. Two final clarifications before we start tomorrow:

1) For files that are encrypted client-side, do you still require the KMS key ID in metadata, or is filename mapping sufficient? Our default pipeline does client-side envelope encryption for PHI-containing logs.
2) If a file fails the CAIQ map (no matching control), will it be rejected outright or sent back into a "needs-mapping" queue for manual triage? We have a small documentation team who will do rapid re-labeling if needed.

Once we confirm those, we'll kick off uploads tomorrow during the 13:00 PT window. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Ari
Ari Kaplan
Security Program Manager
Auriga Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@auriga-health.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal intake + upload timing

Ari — quick answers:

1) Client-side encrypted artifacts: include the KMS key ID in the manifest or metadata. We won't need the plaintext; the metadata lets our pipeline record provenance and the auditor notes. If you must omit, add a short control note in the manifest (e.g., "client_encrypted": true, "kms_key_id": "alias/auriga-cmk").

2) CAIQ mapping failures: files that do not match an automated CAIQ rule are moved to a "needs-mapping" queue rather than being rejected. We'll notify your contact and create a quick triage ticket. The triage path is faster during the onboarding window (aiming for sub-2hr human triage).

Priyom — can you add Auriga as a "partner ingress" to the queue monitoring dashboard and set an alert for more than 50 rejects in 1 hour?

Ben
